literal_meaning: হাত বিস্তার করা (to extend or spread the hand)
figurative_meaning_en: to take or accept a bribe
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে প্রকল্পের অনুমোদনের বিনিময়ে হাত পাতল।
example_sentences_in_english: The officer is known for having his hand out.
He extended his hand in exchange for project approval.
note: This idiom reflects everyday perceptions of corruption in Bengali society.
